description: This file defines the PlatformInfo class, which provides system-specific information and utilities such as OS detection, version determination, and terminal size, used within the webkitpy code base.

classes.name: PlatformInfo
classes.description: Provides system-specific information such as OS type, version, memory, terminal width, and platform details, with methods for OS detection and version parsing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes PlatformInfo with system modules and determines OS name and version.

methods.name: is_mac
methods.description: Returns True if the OS is Mac.

methods.name: is_win
methods.description: Returns True if the OS is Windows.

methods.name: is_cygwin
methods.description: Returns True if the platform is Cygwin.

methods.name: is_linux
methods.description: Returns True if the OS is Linux.

methods.name: is_freebsd
methods.description: Returns True if the OS is FreeBSD.

methods.name: is_highdpi
methods.description: Detects if the display is high DPI (Retina) on Mac.

methods.name: total_bytes_memory
methods.description: Returns total system memory in bytes on Mac.

methods.name: terminal_width
methods.description: Returns terminal width in columns, or sys.maxsize if unknown.

methods.name: linux_distribution
methods.description: Detects Linux distribution type based on filesystem files.

methods.name: _determine_os_name
methods.description: Determines OS name from sys.platform string.

methods.name: _determine_mac_version
methods.description: Determines Mac OS version string from version number.

methods.name: _determine_win_version
methods.description: Determines Windows version string from version tuple.

methods.name: _win_version_tuple
methods.description: Gets Windows version tuple, either via sys module or command.

methods.name: _win_version_tuple_from_cmd
methods.description: Parses Windows version string from command output.
